verdict.rationale:
New Relic's docs describe a single platform ingesting metrics (APM agents), logs (with automatic 'logs in context' linking to APM data), and traces, all queryable together via NRQL/NerdGraph and visualized in shared dashboards, giving SREs cross-signal context in one place (new-relic-docs-24, -29, -30, -32, -35). OpenTelemetry support and infrastructure/APM/logs integration further reinforce unified telemetry pivoting.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that pivoting between signals is seamless in practice (community feedback focuses on cost/UI complaints, not on failure of context-sharing), and no explicit deep-dive on distributed tracing UI beyond passing mentions.
